info.title: theneo-scan — generate an OpenAPI 3.1 document from ASP.NET Core source.
info.description: CLI for Theneo.OpenApiScanner. Generate an OpenAPI 3.1 document from an ASP.NET Core project's source: `theneo-scan build --project ./Api.csproj --out openapi.json`.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Scan once and write the document

options.name: --project
options.description: Path to the .csproj to scan (or set in theneo-scan.json)

options.name: --root
options.description: Project root for config + relative paths (default: cwd)

commands.name: dev
commands.description: [options]   Rescan on save (watch mode: later build)
